title: Writing Emails 1
description: Short, real-life emails: invitations, thank-you notes, questions and cancellations. Aim for 60–80 words.

cards.prompt: Your friend invited you to a party on Saturday, but you can't go. Write a short email: thank them, explain why you can't go and suggest another plan.
followUps: Did you start with a greeting and finish with a closing?
